channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with 6 counts of attempted murder after shooting into Lakeland home: LPD
item.description: A Winter Haven man was charged with six counts of attempted first-degree murder after shooting into a Lakeland home, striking two people, authorities said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Grandmother charged with manslaughter after death of toddler who was left in hot car
item.description: A 74-year-old grandmother was arrested and charged Wednesday in connection with the death of her granddaughter. Police say the grandmother left the sleeping child in the car "unknowingly."

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bucs jewelry designer Kelsey Belmont finds retail home at Heads and Tails in Tampa
item.description: Bucs jewelry designer Kelsey Belmont has found a retail home at Heads and Tails in Tampa. Kelsey hand-makes bracelets and necklaces for all local pro and college teams.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Manatee County has $252 million for storm recovery — here's how homeowners can access their share
item.description: Manatee County is offering federal hurricane recovery funding to homeowners still dealing with damage from Hurricanes Debby, Helene, and Milton. The public has until Monday to weigh in on proposed changes to how the money will be distributed.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New FDEM chief inherits overdue accounting for Florida emergency fund
item.description: Twelve Democratic lawmakers say a report detailing the fund’s balance, purchases and federal reimbursements is 41 days late.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Teen credits helmet for saving his life after e-bike crash, doctors warn of injury increase
item.description: E-bikes are becoming increasingly popular among kids and teens, but pediatric doctors say they are also seeing more young riders with serious injuries after crashes.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk County child death: Grandmother arrested in March car incident
item.description: A Polk County grandmother was arrested months after her 1-year-old granddaughter died in the backseat of her car.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Meta settlement rejection: Florida mother calls $18B payout not enough
item.description: A Florida mother is speaking out against a multi-state settlement with Meta, calling the tech giant's payout inadequate after her teenage son died in 2019.
